remarks:
87.3 Acres of Tillable land with excellent hunting
This 87-acre property is a combination of excellent deer habitat and tillable acres located just minutes east of Cuba NY.  Access is provided by a newer road that crosses the rail road tracks progressing south off of Rt 20 into the field. The Field has been planted in corn (2025) and has a gently slope leading to the woods above.
The forest is a mixed hardwoods mostly, with two stands of planted Norway spruce providing thermal cover for deer.  Approximately 20% of the stand is oak, with the rest being hard and red maple.  The Ash trees have been removed and a professional forester has managed the timber stand recently with a releasing harvest to produce another marketable harvest in eight +/- years.  Then again in another 10 +/- years. This property has a great location for a cabin where a camper is currently located on the hill overlooking the field. 
Deer sign and trails were abundant on all acres of this parcel, and with tillable acres as part of this property food plotting would be a breeze to attract and hold deer on the land.  The Northwest corner is a lowland area with field grasses and old apple trees and some elements of wetlands are present too.
A main logging trail runs central through the woods making access a breeze and wide enough for any side by side or ATV.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Timber and GMO rights convey, Tillable acres,  Electric at the road, 3.85 miles to Cuba,  2.72 miles to Friendship, 3.1 miles to I-86.
